title: A CRASH RESTARTS INTO THE TITLE
why: His answer 44 (2026-10-12): a crash reloads into the title with a note. One error never stopped the game, and it still only goes to the run report. But an error that repeats every frame leaves a frozen or half drawn screen with no way out but closing the tab. Now, when the game faults 10 times inside 3 seconds during play, it abandons the raid (as ABANDON on the pause menu does), saves, and reloads into the title, where a short note says RECOVERED FROM A CRASH and that the error is in your run report. If it crashes again within a minute of that reload, it stays put instead, so a fault at start up can never loop.
now: A game that keeps faulting now saves, abandons the raid and restarts into the title with a short note.
